title: First Occurrence
statementMd:
The array is sorted but may contain **duplicates**. Print the index of the **first** occurrence of x (0-based), or `-1`. Adapt binary search: when you find x, keep searching to the left.

**Input**
Line 1: `n`. Line 2: n integers in non-decreasing order. Line 3: `x`.

**Output**
The first index of x, or `-1`.
hints: When a[mid] == x, record mid as a candidate — then set hi = mid - 1 to look for an earlier one.
Everything else is ordinary binary search.
